<document id="atm-limits">
ATMˆwithdrawalˆlimitsˆHowˆmuchˆcashˆyouˆcanˆtakeˆoutˆeachˆdayˆdependsˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆTheˆlimitˆcoversˆallˆATMsˆcombined,ˆinˆtheˆUSˆandˆabroad.ˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆATMˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$1,500ˆ|ˆTheˆdailyˆlimitˆresetsˆatˆmidnightˆEasternˆTime.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆraiseˆmyˆlimit?ˆNo.ˆLimitsˆareˆsetˆbyˆplan,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆraiseˆthemˆforˆaˆdayˆorˆmakeˆexceptions.ˆTheˆonlyˆwayˆtoˆgetˆaˆhigherˆlimitˆisˆtoˆchangeˆplan.ˆ##ˆATMˆlimitsˆversusˆtheˆATM'sˆownˆlimitˆManyˆATMsˆhaveˆtheirˆownˆmaximumˆperˆwithdrawalˆthat'sˆlowerˆthanˆours.ˆIfˆyouˆneedˆmore,ˆyouˆcanˆmakeˆmoreˆthanˆoneˆwithdrawal,ˆasˆlongˆasˆtheˆtotalˆstaysˆwithinˆyourˆdailyˆlimit.ˆEachˆwithdrawalˆoutsideˆBrookLinkˆmayˆcarryˆaˆfee.ˆCashˆwithdrawalsˆareˆneverˆcoveredˆbyˆCushion.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="transfer-limits-basic">
TransferˆlimitsˆonˆBasicˆTheseˆareˆtheˆtransferˆandˆdepositˆlimitsˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan.ˆ|ˆLimitˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆACHˆtransfersˆout,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆACHˆtransfersˆout,ˆperˆcalendarˆmonthˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆBrookPay,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆDomesticˆwires,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆMobileˆcheckˆdeposits,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositsˆatˆstores,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆDailyˆlimitsˆresetˆatˆmidnightˆEasternˆTime.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆlimitˆresetsˆonˆtheˆfirstˆdayˆofˆeachˆcalendarˆmonth.ˆ##ˆIncomingˆtransfersˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆmoneyˆcomingˆinˆbyˆACH,ˆwire,ˆdirectˆdepositˆorˆBrookPay.ˆ##ˆNewˆdevicesˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆcappedˆatˆ$500.ˆ##ˆNeedˆmore?ˆLimitsˆareˆsetˆbyˆplan.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆraiseˆthem,ˆevenˆforˆoneˆtransfer.ˆChangingˆplanˆisˆtheˆonlyˆwayˆtoˆgetˆhigherˆlimits.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="transfer-limits-plus">
TransferˆlimitsˆonˆPlusˆTheseˆareˆtheˆtransferˆandˆdepositˆlimitsˆonˆtheˆPlusˆplan.ˆ|ˆLimitˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆACHˆtransfersˆout,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆACHˆtransfersˆout,ˆperˆcalendarˆmonthˆ|ˆ$20,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆBrookPay,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆDomesticˆwires,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆMobileˆcheckˆdeposits,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositsˆatˆstores,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆDailyˆlimitsˆresetˆatˆmidnightˆEasternˆTime.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆlimitˆresetsˆonˆtheˆfirstˆdayˆofˆeachˆcalendarˆmonth.ˆ##ˆIncomingˆtransfersˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆmoneyˆcomingˆinˆbyˆACH,ˆwire,ˆdirectˆdepositˆorˆBrookPay.ˆ##ˆNewˆdevicesˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆcappedˆatˆ$500.ˆ##ˆNeedˆmore?ˆLimitsˆareˆsetˆbyˆplan.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆraiseˆthem,ˆevenˆforˆoneˆtransfer.ˆChangingˆplanˆisˆtheˆonlyˆwayˆtoˆgetˆhigherˆlimits.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
